definitions.explanation: Sesame seeds that have been dry-roasted to bring out their nutty flavor and aroma. A ubiquitous condiment and garnish in Japanese cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{炒|い}りごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on a salad.

examples.japanese: {炒|い}りごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{擂|す}り{鉢|ばち}→擂り鉢：07504_suribachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Grinding toasted sesame in a mortar brings out the aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{和|あ}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{炒|い}りごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: For spinach with sesame dressing, use plenty of toasted sesame seeds.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{炒|い}り→炒る：13402_iru⟧ (roasted, from ⟦{炒|い}る→炒る：13402_iru⟧ 'to roast/parch') and ごま (⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧, sesame). Sold in small bags at any Japanese supermarket and used as a finishing garnish or as the base for sesame dressings and sauces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炒|い}りごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふる: to sprinkle toasted sesame seeds
- {炒|い}りごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}る: to grind toasted sesame seeds
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧{炒|い}りごま: toasted white sesame
- ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧{炒|い}りごま: toasted black sesame

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦すりごま→すりごま：23164_surigoma⟧: ground sesame — pre-ground toasted sesame, sold in packages
- ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧ごま: sesame paste — smooth paste made from sesame seeds
- ⟦{白|しろ}ごま→白ごま：23454_shirogoma⟧: white sesame seeds — the most common variety
- ⟦{黒|くろ}ごま→黒ごま：23455_kurogoma⟧: black sesame seeds — stronger flavor, used in sweets and as garnish
- ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧: sesame — the general term

USAGE:
{炒|い}りごま is the most common form of sesame sold for home cooking. It appears in countless Japanese dishes: ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{和|あ}え (sesame-dressed vegetables), ⟦きんぴら→きんぴら：08538_kinpira⟧ (braised root vegetables), ⟦{冷|ひ}やし→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧ (cold noodles), rice balls, and more.
